metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows a daily exercise you can use throughout the day to help unlock a tight back in seconds!

This one is especially good for anyone that sits for long periods of time and needs a quick stretch to instantly get rid of whole back muscle tightness, stiffness, aches, and pain.

It's easy to do, can be done standing pretty much anywhere, and requires no equipment.

Give it a try and let us know how it works for you!
